text:
the ultimate compliment you can be given is head-nod + "he knows some shit"

highest honor. always comes from an old hand slash OG

head nod is to the right. head nod to the left means “look at this jerkoff” or “get this guy the fuck out of here”

its infinitely higher than "knows ball" which is sort of a niche domain expertise thing

it signals that you have some feel for the rhythm of life and the ways of the world, the ineffable, stuff you can't really acquire from books

if I had to rank it:

100. ball knower

[...]

10. Rhodes scholar
5. Nobel laureate

[...]

1. head nod + "knows some shit.”
